=== Ukrainian and Indonesian labels ===

You are right that the pairs framing was superseded. Your four-step path — remove an orphan description, add the label, add a programmatic description, iterate if rejected — is now written down as [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/docs/description_label_policy.md docs/description_label_policy.md], quoted from what you said, with <code>CLAUDE.md</code> pointing at it. It had only ever existed in a chat message, which is why the answer here was still describing the old mechanism.

Measured, descriptions sitting on items with no label in that language: '''id 5,024''', '''uk 4,591''', nl 168, everything else small ([https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/modern-quickstatements/orphan_descriptions_audit.json orphan_descriptions_audit.json]).

: '''→''' The pairs pipeline resolves an orphan description by '''supplying the missing label''', which is what your step 1 protects. Removal is only for the residue where no label can be generated — that is why a blanket 9,615-line removals file was wrong and got deleted.
: '''→''' id is the skipped-branch bug, fixed [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/commit/96e3cb6b 96e3cb6b]; not visible yet because [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/modern-quickstatements/description_label_pairs.txt description_label_pairs.txt] still dates from 08-02 and regenerates on a Sunday run.
: ⚠ '''Step 4 is not built and I am not faking it.''' Iterating on a rejected description needs the rejection readable back, and QuickStatements failures are not read per line.

=== 御笏神社 — yes, it is staged, and I described it wrongly ===

You asked whether [[d:Q110915859|Q110915859]] (御笏神社) is actually being cleaned up. It is: '''3''' removal lines in [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/modern-quickstatements/list_membership_removals.txt list_membership_removals.txt], against [[d:Q11380552|Q11380552]] (List of Shikinaisha in Izu Province). Undelivered only because of the lockout.

I first said the point was that it carries repeated ordinals and the repeats are the defect. That is the same wrong model I retracted today. It is a '''modern shrine''' — it holds '''six''' <code>said to be the same as</code> statements pointing at six different Engishiki entry items, so it is a candidate for six entries — and by your 2026-07-09 rule the list membership belongs to those entry items, not to it. Its <code>part of</code> statements are the damage whether or not any of them repeat, and whether or not they carry ordinals. All three do carry ordinals, which under the old framing would have made them look legitimate.

: '''→''' Removal is correct. Nothing about it depends on the repeats.

: This is to say it is not even a candidate shrine 
:* Oh nvm looking closer it is a candidate shrine for a lot of them at least superficially but it looks like a supershrine pattern
:* Looking at the jawiki page it is pretty clear. It is a candidate shrine itself, but it is a goshi candidate for 4 others
:* '''佐伎多麻比咩命神社'''
This shrine is the only one that it is truly a candidate for

'''Both merges investigated''' — [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/modern-quickstatements/audit_merge_provenance.py audit_merge_provenance.py], which diffs the item either side of each merge edit (a merge blanks its source before redirecting it, so the source itself no longer shows anything).

'''Nothing was lost.''' Both merges only added: 43 statements → 48 → 51, zero removed. And neither source was a duplicate of the shrine — each was '''the shrine as the candidate for one specific entry''':

* [[d:Q135192793|Q135192793]] 御笏神社, 2025-12-01 03:08 — brought ''part of'' the list at ordinal '''20''', ''said to be the same as'' [[d:Q135039648|Q135039648]], official name 加弥命神社, and the coordinates.
* [[d:Q135192871|Q135192871]] 御笏神社(境内社), five minutes later — the '''sessha''' item; brought ordinal '''34''' and ''said to be the same as'' [[d:Q135039658|Q135039658]].

'''So the merges are not the cause of the supershrine — they are a symptom of the same import.''' The real damage predates them and is still sitting there: '''one single''' ''part of'' → [[d:Q11380552|Q11380552]] statement carrying '''five''' ordinals at once (5, 14, 16, 20, 34) with five ''follows'' and five ''followed by'' qualifiers piled into it. That is the piped-link collapse you described. The merges then added properly-formed statements for ordinals 20 and 34, which that one statement already contained — so those two are duplicated, and ''official name'' 加弥命神社 is duplicated for the same reason.

: '''→ And this answers your kana question — the scripts did not crap out.''' The item carries '''five''' ''name in kana'' values: おしゃくじんじゃ, which is right, plus サキタマヒメノ-, ハヤシノ-, カタスカノ-, カミノ- — the readings of four '''entry''' names (佐伎多麻比咩命神社, 波夜志命神社, 片菅命神社, 加弥命神社), truncated with a hyphen. And ミナミコノ, the reading of 南子神社, is stamped as a qualifier on '''five different''' official names. The shrine absorbed the entries' names, so it absorbed their readings.
: '''→''' The three staged removal lines are value-matched <code>-Q110915859|P361|Q11380552</code>, so any one of them takes '''all three''' statements including the five-ordinal one. Right outcome by your rule — a candidate shrine holds no list membership — but worth knowing the ordinals then survive only on the entry items.

=== Why is this P31 still here ===
https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q135041321 has P31 [https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q135009132 Shrines receiving Tsukinami-sai and Niiname-sai offerings] is it still actually running like that or is it just over? IS it gonna be removed by the current logic?

: '''✓ Yes, it is staged for removal, and it is safe.''' <code>-Q135041321|P31|Q135009132</code> sits in [https://github.com/EmmaLeonhart/shintowiki-scripts/blob/main/modern-quickstatements/daily_operations.txt daily_operations.txt] and in <code>migrate_ritsuryo_funding_remove.txt</code>. It is the '''remove half''' of an add-first/remove-later migration that moved these register classifications off ''instance of'' and onto '''shrine ranking''' with a ''determination method'' qualifier. The add half already ran — its file is empty because it is drained.
: [[d:Q135041321|Q135041321]] already carries the migrated form: '''shrine ranking → 月次新嘗''' qualified ''determination method → Q135009120''. So dropping the ''instance of'' loses nothing. The 2026-07-10 audit checked all 4,802 pairs item-by-item and found zero that would destroy an unmigrated fact.
: '''On "is it still running or is it just over"''' — the classification is a 927 ''Engishiki'' register annotation, not a live practice; the imperial 幣帛 distribution it records lapsed centuries ago. But that is not why it is being removed. It is being removed because it was recorded on the wrong property, and the historical fact is kept on the right one.
: ⚠ '''While reading the item I found a separate defect: its migrated statements are DUPLICATED.''' It carries ''shrine ranking → 月次新嘗'' '''twice''' and ''shrine ranking → [[d:Q135160338|Q135160338]]'' '''twice''', each pair identical down to the qualifier. Not staged for anything. Queued as its own item — the question is whether the duplication is item-local or systemic across the migration's ~4,800 items, and that is a measurement, not a guess.
